out.rationale: The passage notes that Michael et al. found no positive results when using LLM debaters and that, because their focus was primarily human debaters, they did not consider cross-play win rates for improving debater capabilities. Michael et al. report 78% judge accuracy for AI debate and 80% for AI consultancy. The passage names a limit of how Michael et al. tested LLM debaters without arguing that their method is flawed, so CHALLENGES is chosen over CRITIQUES.
out.scope: proposed CHALLENGES: Whether LLM debaters help non-expert judges in QuALITY debate; the limit concerns debater capabilities in Michael et al.'s AI debate arm

text: The authors note that Michael et al. (2023) introduced the information-asymmetric QuALITY debate setting but found no positive results with LLM debaters. They point out that Michael et al. focused on human debaters and did not use cross-play win rates to improve debater capabilities.
